construct: SLC22A5 encodes the high-affinity OCTN2 carnitine transporter. Loss of OCTN2 impairs cellular carnitine uptake and renal carnitine reabsorption, causing very low plasma and intracellular carnitine and limiting transport of long-chain fatty acids into mitochondria for beta-oxidation.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Hypoketotic decompensation, cardiomyopathy, very low free carnitine, and biallelic SLC22A5 variants identify primary carnitine deficiency; SLC22A5 encodes the OCTN2 plasma-membrane carnitine transporter.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: CACT is SLC25A20 and acts at the inner mitochondrial membrane; CPT1 and CPT2 are enzymes of the carnitine shuttle; MCAD is ACADM and does not perform cellular carnitine uptake.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: The lead asks for the transport process directly impaired by SLC22A5, so OCTN2-mediated cellular carnitine uptake is uniquely matched to the genotype.
